WHAT_A_FACE_IS: One row per street per assessor block, carrying the lowest and highest house number the assessor publishes on it. An address is on the face whose street matches and whose range contains its number.
NOT_A_CLAIM_ABOUT_THE_RECORD: This says which block an address is on. It does not say the Board of Supervisors ever decided anything there; the fiche answers that.
COLUMNS_JOIN_BY_POSITION: `s`, `lo`, `hi` and `b` are parallel. `streets` is the label per street id, and the faces are sorted by (s, lo).
